text:
ITEM 1 | Bright red whole strawberries and halved/sliced strawberries, glossy wet surface, juicy, piled in the upper center of the plate, pieces about 1-3 cm | 75
ITEM 2 | Small deep red raspberries, matte, clustered with a few dark blueberries, upper area near strawberries, berries about 1-2 cm each | 30
ITEM 3 | Diced pale yellow pineapple chunks, glossy and moist with cut faces, scattered across the right side of the plate, cubes about 1.5-2.5 cm | 130
ITEM 4 | Cubed watermelon pieces, bright pink-red with slightly translucent edges, mixed among strawberries in the center-left, cubes about 1.5-2 cm | 40
ITEM 5 | Crumbly off-white soft cheese-like mass with irregular curds and a few flecks of black pepper, lying on the left side of the plate, spread about 6x5 cm and roughly 1.5 cm high | 60
ITEM 6 | Round brown-edged sausage-like patties or slices, lightly browned exterior with a matte, slightly grainy surface, lower left of the plate, each about 2-2.5 cm in diameter and about 1 cm thick (roughly four pieces) | 50
ITEM 7 | Small orange carrot cubes or sticks with firm, slightly glossy surface, scattered near the sausage pieces at the lower left, each about 1 cm | 10
ITEM 8 | Scattered small dark blueberries, deep blue-black with a slight bloom, mixed among the other fruit at the top center | 8
